result.topic_en: A representation of the 20 vertices of the dodecahedron inscribed in a sphere of radius √15, written as pairs (P, Q) with P a complex number built from fifth roots of unity ρ and Q the third coordinate.
result.transcription:
Die 20 Ecken des Dodecaeders; Halbmesser der Kugel = [-?-]$\sqrt{15}$
werden am zierlichsten dargestellt durch
$(P, Q)$, wo $P$ die [-comp-] beiden ersten Coordinaten complex, $Q$
die dritte Coordinate darstellt, [-in folgenden 4 Gruppen-]
[-1) $P = 2(1-\rho)\rho^n$, $Q = \rho+\rho^2-\rho^3-\rho^4$-]
2) [-$P = -2(1-\rho)\rho^n$  $Q = \rho^2+\rho^4-\rho^6-\rho^8$ =-] $-\rho+\rho^2-\rho^3+\rho^4$
und wo $P = 2(\rho-\rho^4)\rho^n$, $Q =$ [-$\rho+\rho^2 \ldots \rho^4$-] $\rho-\rho\rho+\rho^3-\rho^4$
und endlich wo für $n$ alle Werthe 0,1,2,3,4 und für $\rho$ alle
imaginären Werthe zu substituiren sind.
[-St-][?]

methods.what: Representation of the dodecahedron's 20 vertices (on a sphere of radius √15) as (P, Q), where P is the complex coordinate x+iy and Q is the height, using fifth roots of unity ρ

methods.what: Explicit vertex formula: P as a fifth-root-of-unity expression rotated by ρ^n, Q as an alternating sum of powers of ρ
Ranges of the parameters: n runs over 0,1,2,3,4 and ρ over all imaginary fifth roots of unity
methods.quote:
für $n$ alle Werthe 0,1,2,3,4 und für $\rho$ alle
imaginären Werthe zu substituiren sind.
